record.question: Which of the following is NOT a water borne disease?
record.explanation: Answer B: Brucellosis. Brucellosis is principally acquired from infected animals or unpasteurized dairy and is not classically a waterborne disease; cholera and typhoid are waterborne risks. Reference: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/brucellosis; https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/typhoid. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
